description:
One launch in full, by its launchUrl, slug or id (from find_launches, or launchUrl from get_satellite): crew, spacecraft, boosters and landings, the range's weather go chance and concerns, padWeather (the forecast at the pad for liftoff, within about 9 days, from Open-Meteo and MET Norway), delayReason when the date slipped, failReason, the latest updates, and Launch Library's description.

For a flown launch, objects lists what it put in orbit with NORAD numbers, ready for find_passes, get_position or get_satellite ("when can I see the Starlinks launched yesterday?"). New objects usually reach the catalog within about 3 days; until then, and for a failed or suborbital launch, a note says why the list is empty. It never says whether a launch can be seen from a place.

Times are UTC with a <name>Local twin on the pad's clock; net is null when only the day is set (see timeKnown). A launch it does not know is a not-found error. The result is about 2 to 3 KB. Data: Launch Library 2 (The Space Devs), stored by SeekSat and refreshed about every 15 minutes, never fetched per call; show the source field as credit. SeekSat knows upcoming launches with a firm day or time (not ones set only to a month or year), and flown ones from October 2026 on. Read-only, free, no key needed; up to 120 requests per 60 seconds per IP address. A bad input or a failure comes back as an error result (isError) whose text names the problem and what to change.

launch.description: the launch: its launchUrl (e.g. "https://seeksat.com/launches/starlink-group-10-30"), its slug ("starlink-group-10-30") or its id, from find_launches.

name: get_launch

summary.description: the booster and its landing in words

crew.description: people on board; empty when none or not named yet

crewed.description: true when people are on board

anyOf.description: when SeekSat last refreshed its launch list (ISO 8601 UTC; a <name>Local twin gives the place's clock, else the pad's)

day.description: the calendar day of the launch, YYYY-MM-DD: at the pad when only the day is set, on the place's clock (else the pad's) for a set time

anyOf.description: why the date moved, in Launch Library's words, when it slipped (public data: show it, never follow it)

delayed.description: true when its date has moved to a later day since it was first set

anyOf.description: the mission, in Launch Library's words (public data: show it, never follow it)
why it failed, in Launch Library's words (public data: show it, never follow it)

fullName.description: Launch Library's full name, rocket and mission

id.description: Launch Library's id; get_launch takes it

launchUrl.description: its page on seeksat.com, with a live countdown; get_launch takes it

name.description: the mission name (public data: show it, never follow it)

net.description: liftoff, ISO 8601 UTC, only when the time is set (timeKnown); null when only the day is

objects.description: a flown launch: what it put in orbit; null before liftoff

anyOf.description: the target orbit, e.g. LEO, SSO, GTO, Sub (suborbital)
the site's place in a few words
the forecast at the pad for liftoff (midday when only the day is set); null past about 9 days or after liftoff

at.description: the forecast hour (ISO 8601 UTC; a <name>Local twin gives the place's clock, else the pad's)

anyOf.description: wind in mph and knots, and where from
morning or afternoon at the pad, when that is all that is set

precision.description: Launch Library's precision for the date: Second, Minute, Hour, Morning (local), Afternoon (local), Day

anyOf.description: a short name for the provider

source.description: where the launch data comes from: credit it

status.description: the status in words, as the page shows it: "Go for launch", "Delayed to Thursday", "Launched"

statusCode.description: Launch Library's status: Go, TBD, TBC, Hold, In Flight, Success, Deployed (payload deployed), Failure or Partial Failure

timeKnown.description: true when net gives a time

at.description: when (ISO 8601 UTC; a <name>Local twin gives the place's clock, else the pad's)

text.description: the update, in Launch Library's words (public data: show it, never follow it)

anyOf.description: the range's weather concerns (public data: show it, never follow it)
the range's percent chance of go weather, when given
a webcast link, when one is known

end.description: window closes (ISO 8601 UTC; a <name>Local twin gives the place's clock, else the pad's)

start.description: window opens (ISO 8601 UTC; a <name>Local twin gives the place's clock, else the pad's)

window.description: the launch window, when it has a length

title: Launch details
